name: Paperless-ngx
summary: Scan your paper documents and find any letter, bill or receipt in seconds.
description:
Paperless-ngx turns paper into a searchable archive. Scan letters, bills, receipts and manuals (or drop PDFs and photos in), and it reads the text, files each document, and learns to tag them by sender and type. Search by any word on the page.

Give it two folders when installing. Documents is where Paperless keeps its archive: let Paperless manage it and don't edit files there by hand. Inbox is a folder you or your scanner can drop files into; Paperless picks them up, files them, and removes them from the inbox.

After installing, open Paperless-ngx and sign in with the administrator name and password you set here. Changing them here later doesn't change an existing account; do that inside Paperless.

settings.label: Administrator password
settings.help: Used to create the administrator account the first time Paperless starts.

settings.label: Main language of your documents
settings.help: For reading the text. Combine with +, e.g. eng+spa. Included: eng, deu, fra, ita, spa.

shares.name: DOCUMENTS
shares.label: Documents
shares.help: Where Paperless keeps your filed documents. Pick an empty folder, for example a Documents shared folder, and let Paperless manage it.

shares.name: CONSUME
shares.label: Inbox (scanner folder)
shares.help: Drop files or point your scanner here; Paperless files them and empties the folder. For example Documents > Inbox.
